snippet.title: SuperLite 1500 Series: Asteroids - MiruMiru PlayStation Trailer
snippet.description:
This preview of the 1998 Asteroids remake was featured on one of the Japanese demo discs, MiruMiru PlayStation. The Japanese version was released under the SuperLite 1500 Series.

Asteroids (C) Atari Interactive
SuperLite series (C) SUCCESS Corporation
